visitor.name: Visitor
visitor.personality: Signs in and checks their own session — proves auth end to end

nadia.name: Nadia Rahman
goals: Get a room for the nights she needs without phoning anyone
nadia.description: Travels for work most months, books late and changes plans
nadia.personality: Brisk. Books from her phone between meetings, and will abandon a form that asks for anything she has already given.

rafa.name: Rafa Oliveira
goals: Get every arrival into a clean room without keeping anyone waiting
rafa.description: Works the front desk on early shift
rafa.personality: Unflappable. Does three things at once and expects the arrivals list to be right without refreshing it.

priya.name: Priya Nair
goals: Clear the turnover list before the afternoon arrivals
priya.description: Turns rooms around between departures and arrivals
priya.personality: Methodical. Works a floor at a time and marks a room done the moment it is, not at the end of the round.

morgan.name: Morgan Ellis
goals: Spot a bad week before it finishes
morgan.description: Runs the property — rates, staffing and what the numbers say
morgan.personality: Impatient with detail. Wants occupancy and revenue on one screen and will not click twice for it.
